name: PNB 5105
title: Seminar in Intraoperative Neuromonitoring
description: Presentations of clinical and nonclinical topics affecting the daily job of an intraoperative neuromonitoring clinician. Topics may include the sterile field; infection control; needle, electrical, radiation and fire safety; patient privacy laws (HIPAA); professional conduct and communication; and diversity in the workplace. May be repeated for a total of 4 credits.
